eps.ov: Brothers Rozé and Ash take action in the Northern Lands now conquered by the Neo-Britannian Empire.
Rozé and Ash take on a mission to rescue Kensei Kuroto, the leader of the Seven Shining Stars.
Rozé and Ash each take a break after the fight against Neo-Britannia.
A transport ship arrives with supplies. The new Knightmare Frame model comes accompanied.
A rescue operation is launched to save the Japanese from the Sky Fortress Damocles and F.L.E.I.J.A.
Under Kuroto's command, the Stars, Rozé and Ash, are forced to make a decision to stop Damocles.
Rozé who believed Ash to be his father’s enemy, visits the Lavender Home where Ash was raised.
As a result of Christoph's interrogations into the secret of Geass, the resistance base is raided.
The SSS are devastated and Rozé is in a hopeless situation. They receive intel of a proposed peace.

Unidentified machines begin to appear around the world, causing fear and confusion. Fighters in every country take on the machines with their Knightmare Frames, but prove to be no match against their overwhelming numbers and strength.

An unidentified machines cause worldwide chaos. Norland tries to move on to the next stage of his plan. The team realise that something must be done about the Situmpe Wall in order to thwart his plan. Rozé launches an operation to nullify the wall.
Disheartened by the enemy, Ash turns the Geass curse into a vow and faces the final battle.
